kind: Prospective local machine audit of original source fields against frozen RDF
sampling: Lowest SHA256 of seed, working group, relation, direction, original source identity or frozen subject identity, separated by newline; no replacement for missing, unreadable, unmatched or ambiguous records. Source candidate selection is independent of agreement labels.

source_frames.MODIFIES_SECTION: Original TSG ZIP members in Rel-15 through Rel-19 whose filename contains a CR number and a RAN working-group TDoc identifier; .doc and .docx both remain in frame. No parsed JSON is a sampling frame or source truth.
source_frames.SENT_TO: Original retained meeting-list XLSX rows whose Type contains LS and whose To cell is nonempty; repeated document appearances remain separate source identities.
source_frames.REFERENCES: Explicitly labelled Agreement, Conclusion or Working Assumption passages independently read from retained meeting DOCX, with at least one TDoc identifier. Raw downloaded ZIP byte identity is checked and unreadable/unmatched raw provenance remains unresolved.
source_frames.MADE_AT: Explicitly labelled decision passages from retained meeting DOCX. Containing original report establishes an occurrence, not unique identity or absence from other meetings.
source_frames.RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO: The same independently read explicit decision passage frame; closest preceding numbered heading is a machine candidate agenda label, not expert adjudication.

graph_frame: Frozen RDF subjects with at least one target edge of the relation, sampled as records rather than individual edges. All target edges of the selected record are retained, including multiple meeting targets.
comparison: Bidirectional exact set differences where the original field is fully readable and its document and edition can be bound without ambiguity. Raw clause tokens, source citation identifiers and recipient roles are compared separately from semantic meaning and target-identity resolution. Substring matches and unresolved identities remain unadjudicated.
reference_semantics: Explicit supportive, contextual and mere-citation cues are machine tags; no human or independent domain-expert semantic labels are claimed.
resource_policy: Unchanged existing guard_codex_measurement wrapper; systemd MemoryMax=2G, MemoryHigh=1G, MemorySwapMax=0, TasksMax=64, CPU affinity 0,1, nice 19; Windows and WSL available-memory reserve 16GiB. Missing guard visibility stops the owned job.
protected_inputs: Frozen TTL, original ZIP/XLSX/DOCX and production parsing code are read-only. Original-input SHA256 values are checked before and after the audit; changes invalidate affected comparisons. No database access, model calls, external publication or modifications to other tracks.
interpretation: Balanced fixed diagnostic sample, not a representative survey or corpus accuracy estimate. Completeness refers only to the completely read sampled source field or passage. Unreadable, missing, ambiguous and unadjudicated records stay in requested denominators. No confidence interval or full-corpus recall is reported.
